def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Horizontal 5-segment: copy the color strip immediately below it
    # across the segment's span, preserving the 5 barrier.
    for r in range(h):
        cs = [c for c, v in enumerate(g[r]) if v == 5]
        if not cs:
            continue
        # maximal contiguous segments
        segs = []
        start = prev = cs[0]
        for c in cs[1:]:
            if c != prev + 1:
                segs.append((start, prev))
                start = c
            prev = c
        segs.append((start, prev))
        for a, b in segs:
            if r + 1 < h and all(g[r+1][c] != 5 for c in range(a, b+1)):
                seed = [g[rr][a] for rr in range(r+1, h) if g[rr][a] not in (0, 5)]
                # If a vertical colored strip descends below the left endpoint,
                # tile it across the width of the horizontal barrier.
                if seed:
                    sr = [rr for rr in range(r+1, h) if g[rr][a] not in (0, 5)]
                    for j, rr in enumerate(sr):
                        for c in range(a, b+1):
                            if g[rr][c] == 0:
                                g[rr][c] = seed[j % len(seed)]
    # Vertical 5-segments: a colored tile to the right at the bottom is
    # extended upward along the segment, periodically matching the seed rows.
    for c in range(w):
        rs = [r for r in range(h) if g[r][c] == 5]
        if not rs:
            continue
        segs = []
        start = prev = rs[0]
        for r in rs[1:]:
            if r != prev + 1:
                segs.append((start, prev))
                start = r
            prev = r
        segs.append((start, prev))
        for a, b in segs:
            # Look for a contiguous colored tile immediately right of the line
            # along the last rows; use all rows with data in this right-hand strip.
            right = [cc for cc in range(c+1, w) if any(g[r][cc] not in (0, 5) for r in range(max(a,b-3), b+1))]
            if not right:
                continue
            # Data rows at/below the segment's lower end define tile period.
            data_rows = [r for r in range(max(a, b-3), b+1) if any(g[r][cc] not in (0, 5) for cc in right)]
            if not data_rows:
                continue
            patterns = [[g[r][cc] for cc in right] for r in data_rows]
            for r in range(a, b+1):
                pattern = patterns[(r-a) % len(patterns)]
                for j, cc in enumerate(right):
                    if g[r][cc] == 0:
                        g[r][cc] = pattern[j]
    return g
PY
